matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies that Section 4.2's unified actor loss includes β_div·L_div and β_dyn·L_dyn terms, but Appendix I.2 Eq. (8) omits them. This directly detects the ground truth defect: the corrupted text added these terms to Section 4.2, creating an inconsistency with the appendix definition that originally had only three terms. The finding correctly identifies the incomplete/conflicting definitions across sections.

Finding 2 discusses dimensional inconsistency in Eq. (5) involving action vector differences, which is unrelated to gt_id 2's defect about inconsistent aggregation (mean vs min) in EDAC's update_actor pseudocode. The findings do not mention the critic update formulas or the mean/min aggregation issue at all, so this is not detected.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly detects the inconsistency in unified actor loss definitions between Section 4.2 and Appendix (gt_id 1).
Identifies a dimensional inconsistency in Eq. (5) that is not among the ground truth defects but appears to be a valid observation about the paper.
